match.detail: Base UI sets `data-starting-style` and `data-ending-style` only while the element enters or leaves

entries.reason: The enter and exit styles #707 gave the popup, its fade, scale and slide. Base UI sets these attributes only while the popup enters or leaves, and the capture reads it at rest.
The trigger is a `<button>` that sets no `text-align`, so the browser's default style sheet centres its text, as button.json classifies.
